title: .hack//INTERMEZZO
justification: AniList 1143 (SPECIAL, 1 episode, 2003) is AniDB 24's special S1 "Intermezzo", aired 2003-03-28. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 48, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 24, and the special's title matches the AniList title. AniList gives the year only, so the start-date check cannot apply; the title and the 1-episode count agree. TVDB 79099 places the special at S0E1 "Intermezzo", 2003-03-28, the same date; the node's mapping list leaves S1 unlisted, so it lands on S0E1 by default.
